_comment: EXAMPLE DATA ONLY. Replace the contents of this file with the official CompTIA exam objectives for whatever exam you are studying (download the objectives PDF/spreadsheet from comptia.org and transcribe the domains/objectives below). Keep the schema: { exam, domains: [ { id, name, weight, objectives: [ { id, text } ] } ] }. The '_comment' key itself is ignored by the app and can stay or go.

objectives.text: Compare and contrast the display components of mobile devices, including LCD, OLED, and digitizer technology.
Explain common networking ports, protocols, and services, including how DHCP assigns an IP address to a client step by step.
Compare and contrast wireless networking protocols and encryption standards, including WPA2 and WPA3.
Given a scenario, select and install storage devices, including the differences between SSD, HDD, and NVMe.
